scripts.dev: bun run dev:api & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/api lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.db:down: ssh oracle 'cd /home/ubuntu/unigym && sudo docker compose down'

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bunx lint-staged && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
